bottleneck.description: Legacy GEO FSS operator pivoting to Lightspeed LEO constellation; capacity and customer set is substitutable with SES, Intelsat, Eutelsat OneWeb, and Starlink.

dependency.key_customers: Bell Canada, Canadian government, US DoD (some), broadcasters, enterprise data customers
dependency.key_suppliers: MDA Space (Lightspeed prime), SpaceX (launch), MELCO (older satellites)

editorial.notes: Telesat's existing GEO fleet competes directly with SES, Intelsat, Eutelsat, and ABS in fixed satellite services with no unique bottleneck position. The Lightspeed LEO constellation full-service date has slipped to end-Q1 2028 due to chip supply delays, and creditors are litigating over a September 2025 equity distribution to shield Lightspeed equity from $1.7B of debt maturing December 2026. Going-concern flag set: 2025 net loss of $530M, GEO revenue declining 25%+, refinancing or bankruptcy explicitly disclosed as a risk. Structural bottleneck rating remains LOW; financial distress flagged separately.
